text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: multiple alerts firing for metrics-scrape-proxy (x18) and log-ingest-queue (x12). Autopage triggered. Escalation policy: metrics-pipeline -> eng-sre -> oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: grabbing this. seeing a spike in 5xx from scrape-proxy, and kafka consumer lag rising. will start triage.

maria: confirmed, grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/metric-pipeline?panelId=7 shows scrape error rate jumped at 12:04 UTC, pod restarts around same time.

alex: adding context: we pushed exporter config change ~11:58 in us-west that rolled ~12:01. Could be related.

oncall-sre: good call. checking k8s events and rollout. `kubectl get rs -n infra | grep scrape-proxy` -> seeing a new replicaset. logs show `error reading from target: EOF`.

paul: paging notes: a few PD incidents already acked by incidentbot auto-ack of the first sig. but some duplicates remain unacked (PD flurry). looks like PD dedupe window didn't consolidate because different alert labels (job vs export endpoint).

oncall-sre: running quick mitigation: scaling scrape-proxy to 6 -> 12 to handle spike and give time for rollback if needed.

ops-bot: command executed by oncall-sre: `kubectl scale deploy/scrape-proxy -n infra --replicas=12` ✅

maria: scaling helped reduce 5xx rate marginally. but kafka consumer lag still climbing — log-ingest topic consumer group at ~45k messages behind.

alex: is there a backlog in our s3 drain? consumers might be slowed by S3 429s. checking s3 metrics.

oncall-sre: i see increased 429s from s3 in last 8m. that will slow log shard forwarders, causing queue. we should enable degraded-mode routing for non-prod logs to reduce pressure.

paul: i'm going to flip routing rules for non-prod to retention-short circuit. @ops-bot can you run the toggle?

ops-bot: routing change staged by paul: `feature-toggle set nonprod-log-degraded true` -> applied to edge router. will propagate in ~30s.

maria: quick reminder: customer-visible metric missing set: `requests.duration` for a small subset of customers in us-west. Customer-ops pinged for impact.

customer-ops: getting reports from a customer on missing dashboards. they see zeros for some backend metrics since ~12:03. they say product telemetry is impacted but not user-facing features.

oncall-sre: ok prioritize: (1) stop new backlog growth (done via scaling + routing), (2) shore up exporter rollout (rollback candidate ready), (3) start catch-up for kafka consumers if S3 429s subside.

alex: i can roll back the exporter change. will prepare a rollback patch and hold for approval.

paul: timeline/next actions: rollback exporter if errors persist after scaling; if rollback not needed, keep increased fleet and monitor consumer lag trend for 15m. once lag <5k, start controlled resume of non-prod routing.

oncall-sre: executing health checks and will post back in 5m. adding `#incident` tag in channel.

incidentbot: PD: incident 234512 escalated to eng-sre; current status: acknowledged by oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: quick status 12:12 UTC: 5xx rate down 40%, kafka lag growth slowed but still +2k per min. S3 429s trending down after retry-window adjustment from storage team.

maria: agree — dashboards show consumer lag plateauing. i recommend no rollback yet, continue monitoring.

customer-ops: updated customer: "we're investigating missing telemetry; not affecting product functionality; we'll notify when restores are verified." they asked for ETA — given current pace, estimate 30–60m for full catch-up.

alex: i'll hold rollback on standby, prepping `kubectl rollout undo` steps and health probes.

oncall-sre: logging a short postmortem ticket: PM-2349, include root cause hypothesis (exporter config + bursty scrape causing transient 5xx + S3 throttle). tagging infra and storage.

paul: final note: after traffic normalizes, we should add an autopage dedupe rule for similar alerts (match on short hash of target canonical name) to reduce pager storms from near-identical failures. filing infra-ops ticket.

incidentbot: All alerts for metrics-scrape-proxy and log-ingest-queue have been resolved/closed by alertmanager at 12:26 UTC.

oncall-sre: closing the incident thread — will update PM-2349 with timeline and actions. handing off to follow-on owners: maria (metrics), storage team (S3 throttling), infra (exporter rollout review).

maria: thanks. good ride. will post post-incident notes once PM ticket has initial draft. :thumbsup:

customer-ops: will keep customer updated with the PM ticket link when available.
